_meta.title: Video Range Edit v1
_meta.description: Extend video-frame-edit-v1.json from a single frame to a frame range: the caller draws a mask on frame 1 only, RAFT optical flow propagates it forward across the batch so the edit tracks motion instead of staying pinned to frame 1's pixel coordinates. RAFT node verified against ComfyUI-Buff-Nodes' RaftOpticalFlowNode (2026-09-01 web search).
_meta.status: template, needs design work not a naming fix (confirmed 2026-09-02, P-043) — VideoHelperSuite nodes are real and correctly named; RaftOpticalFlowNode (ComfyUI-Buff-Nodes) is real but returns a flow VISUALIZATION IMAGE, not a usable flow field, so no mask-warp node can consume its output regardless of what it is called. See workflows/README.md Status for the two candidate fixes. Propagation quality on fast motion or occlusion remains unverified.

1._note: VideoHelperSuite LoadVideo node. frame_load_cap bounds the edited range; 0 = whole clip.

2._note: User-drawn mask for frame 1 only. Later frames' masks come from RAFT propagation (node 4), not from this image.

4._note: Computes dense optical flow across the loaded frame batch; downstream node 5 warps the frame-1 mask along that flow field for every subsequent frame.

5._note: Not a built-in ComfyUI node — a placeholder for whatever flow-warp node ships with the installed RAFT pack (packs differ here; ComfyUI-Buff-Nodes, Code2Collapse's mask-propagation pack, and comfyui-optical-flow each name this step differently). Confirm the real class_type before use.

inputs.text: flicker, temporal inconsistency, blurry, lowres, artifacts, watermark

9._note: Batched over the full loaded frame range; masks come from node 5, one per frame.

12._note: VideoHelperSuite. Re-assembles the edited frame batch back into a video file.
